title: A specialized reasoning large language model for accelerating rare disease diagnosis: a randomized AI physician assistance trial
summary: Rare diseases affect millions of individuals worldwide, yet timely diagnosis remains a major public health challenge due to scarcity of specialized clinical expertise. While large language models (LLMs) show promise to support rare disease diagnosis, current models are constrained by insufficient clinical deployability, limited clinically grounded evidence, and scarcity of training data. Here we present RaDaR (Rare Disease navigatoR), an open-source, compact reasoning LLM (32B parameters) for rare disease diagnosis. RaDaR was trained with 49,170 publicly available free-text cases and 104,666 synthetic cases with reasoning-enhanced training. RaDaR showed the strongest performance among evaluated open-source models, including the 671B DeepSeek-R1, across public benchmarks and four external validation centers. In a retrospective cohort, RaDaR prioritized the final diagnosis before documented clinical suspicion in 61.06 percent of cases, corresponding to a potential lead time of 1.87 months and 50.18 percent of the within-center interval. In a randomized physician-assistance trial, RaDaR assistance improved physicians' rare-disease diagnostic accuracy by 21.44 percentage points compared with internet search alone. Synthetic-data ablations suggested that phenotype-anchored narratives provide useful training signal for long-tail rare diseases, with a monotonic scaling trend within the tested data range. Together, RaDaR and its development and validation framework provide a deployable rare-disease reasoning model and a reproducible development framework for diagnostic AI under data scarcity.
tldr: RaDaR is an open-source, 32B-parameter reasoning LLM for rare disease diagnosis, trained on public and synthetic data, that improved diagnostic accuracy by 21.44 percentage points in a randomized physician-assistance trial and enabled earlier diagnosis in 61% of cases.
tldr_zh: RaDaR是一个开源、32B参数的推理大语言模型，用于罕见病诊断，通过公开和合成数据训练，在随机医生辅助试验中将诊断准确率提高了21.44个百分点，并在61%的病例中实现了更早的诊断。
summary_zh: 罕见病影响着全球数百万人，但由于缺乏专业临床知识，及时诊断仍是一个重大公共卫生挑战。尽管大语言模型（LLM）在支持罕见病诊断方面展现出潜力，但当前模型受限于临床可部署性不足、临床循证依据有限以及训练数据匮乏。在此，我们提出RaDaR（罕见病导航器），一个用于罕见病诊断的开源、紧凑型推理大语言模型（320亿参数）。RaDaR基于49,170例公开可用的自由文本病例和104,666例经推理增强训练的合成病例进行训练。在公开基准测试和四个外部验证中心中，RaDaR在评估的开源模型（包括6710亿参数的DeepSeek-R1）中表现出最强性能。在一项回顾性队列中，RaDaR在61.06%的病例中优先于临床记录的可疑诊断之前给出最终诊断，对应潜在提前时间1.87个月，占中心内诊断间隔的50.18%。在一项随机医师辅助试验中，与仅使用互联网搜索相比，RaDaR辅助将医师的罕见病诊断准确率提高了21.44个百分点。合成数据消融实验表明，表型锚定叙述为长尾罕见病提供了有用的训练信号，且在测试数据范围内呈现单调扩展趋势。综上，RaDaR及其开发与验证框架提供了一个可部署的罕见病推理模型，以及在数据稀缺条件下实现诊断AI的可复现开发框架。

title: E-MRL: Cross-view Aligned Evidence-driven Multimodal Reinforcement Learning for Reliable 3D Tumor Analysis
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show great promise in volumetric medical report generation, they frequently suffer from visual hallucinations and a lack of grounding in 3D CT data. Current Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) strategies typically optimize text fidelity alone, essentially rewarding correct diagnoses derived from language priors rather than genuine visual perception. To address this, we propose cross-view aligned Evidence-driven Multimodal Reinforcement Learning (Evidence-MRL, noted as E-MRL), a reliable RL reasoning framework that formulates the generation process as a Markov Decision Process of "diagnosis-localization-verification". Unlike standard approaches, our model is explicitly trained to identify a "key evidence slice" alongside the global diagnostic report, grounding its findings in verifiable visual evidence. Crucially, we introduce a novel cross-view consistency reward, which validates the semantic alignment between the golden-standard report and a local visual re-query of the selected key slice, providing additional rewards for correctly-localized reasoning. Experiments on large-scale 3D CT tumor datasets demonstrate that E-MRL significantly reduces hallucinations and improves diagnostic accuracy compared to SFT and RL baselines, offering a clinically interpretable solution for visually-grounded and tumor analysis.
tldr: Proposes E-MRL, a multimodal RL framework for 3D CT tumor analysis that uses cross-view consistency reward to ground reports in visual evidence, reducing hallucinations.
tldr_zh: 提出了E-MRL，一种用于3D CT肿瘤分析的多模态强化学习框架，通过交叉视图一致性奖励将报告基于视觉证据，减少幻觉。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
尽管视觉-语言模型（VLM）在三维医学报告生成领域展现出巨大潜力，但它们常出现视觉幻觉且缺乏对3D CT数据的可信依据。当前的监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）策略通常仅优化文本保真度，实质上是奖励源自语言先验而非真实视觉感知的正确诊断。为解决这一问题，我们提出跨视角对齐的循证多模态强化学习（Evidence-MRL，简称E-MRL），这是一种可靠的强化学习推理框架，将生成过程形式化为“诊断-定位-验证”的马尔可夫决策过程。与标准方法不同，我们的模型被明确训练为在生成全局诊断报告的同时识别“关键证据切片”，从而将诊断结果锚定于可验证的视觉证据。关键之处在于，我们引入了一种新颖的跨视角一致性奖励，该奖励通过验证金标准报告与所选关键切片的局部视觉再查询之间的语义对齐，为正确定位的推理提供额外奖励。在大型3D CT肿瘤数据集上的实验表明，与SFT和RL基线方法相比，E-MRL显著减少了幻觉现象并提升了诊断准确率，为基于视觉证据的肿瘤分析提供了一种临床可解释的解决方案。

title: MedPCFM: Improving Medical Point Cloud Completion by Integrating Point Transformers and Flow Matching
summary: Medical point cloud completion is important for anatomical reconstruction and downstream clinical workflows, yet generative modeling in this setting remains insufficiently studied. We investigate completion through continuous-time generative modeling and introduce PCFM, a PTv3-backed flow matching approach for medical point cloud completion. We evaluate on SkullFix and SkullBreak, and additionally on the more recent Mandibular Defect dataset. We build strong baselines by adapting PTv3 to a deterministic encoder-decoder completion model and by instantiating diffusion completion (PCDiff) with both PVCNN and PTv3 denoisers. PCFM with PTv3 is competitive with the deterministic PTv3 baseline and achieves state-of-the-art generative performance across datasets, while requiring substantially fewer sampling steps than diffusion. At the best operating points, PTv3 also yields clear throughput gains, providing up to a 7$\times$ speed-up for PCFM compared to a PVCNN backbone. Finally, we study empirical scaling trends by varying model size and point cardinality, showing consistent gains with higher point resolution and informative trade-offs across model scales.
tldr: This paper introduces PCFM, a flow matching approach using Point Transformer v3 for medical point cloud completion, achieving state-of-the-art generative performance on skull and mandibular defect datasets with fewer sampling steps than diffusion models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出PCFM，一种基于Point Transformer v3和流匹配的医学点云补全方法，在颅骨和下颌骨缺损数据集上实现了生成性能的最优，且采样步数远少于扩散模型。
summary_zh: 摘要：医学点云补全对于解剖结构重建和下游临床工作流程至关重要，然而该场景下的生成建模研究仍不充分。我们通过连续时间生成建模探索补全问题，并引入PCFM——一种基于PTv3的流匹配方法，用于医学点云补全。我们在SkullFix和SkullBreak数据集上进行评估，并额外在最新的下颌骨缺损数据集上进行了验证。通过将PTv3适配为确定性编码器-解码器补全模型，并利用PVCNN和PTv3去噪器实例化扩散补全（PCDiff），我们构建了强大的基线方法。基于PTv3的PCFM与确定性PTv3基线方法具有竞争力，并在多个数据集上实现了最先进的生成性能，同时所需的采样步数远少于扩散方法。在最佳运行点，PTv3还带来了显著的吞吐量增益，相比PVCNN骨干网络，PCFM最高可实现7倍加速。最后，我们通过改变模型规模和点数量研究了经验缩放趋势，结果表明更高的点分辨率能带来持续的性能提升，且不同模型规模间存在有信息量的权衡。

title: T2D-Bench: Evidence-Gated Evaluation of LLM Outputs for Type 2 Diabetes Using a Multi-Layer Clinical-Lifestyle Knowledge Graph
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can produce clinically fluent recommendations for type 2 diabetes while failing to satisfy guideline constraints or explicitly justify lifestyle-related glycemic claims. We present T2D-Bench, a reproducible benchmark and evidence-gated evaluation framework for testing whether LLM outputs satisfy explicit, graph-checkable evidence requirements. T2D-Bench is built on a multi-layer clinical-lifestyle knowledge graph that combines a biomedical spine (UMLS, DrugBank, SIDER), computable ADA Standards of Care rules, and lifestyle knowledge connected through a mechanistic bridge to glycemic laboratory effects. Across 100 structured vignettes spanning diagnosis, medication safety, and adversarial lifestyle conflicts, baseline outputs failed benchmark-defined evidence-path checks in 35% of cases for GPT-4o-mini and 33% for GPT-4o. The evidence gate detects unsupported omissions and uses constrained revision to bring outputs into verifier-level compliance with benchmark-defined evidence requirements. These results show that computable evidence constraints can make unsupported clinical omissions explicit, measurable, and correctable in diabetes-focused LLM outputs.
tldr: T2D-Bench is a benchmark and evidence-gated evaluation framework for LLM outputs on type 2 diabetes, built on a multi-layer clinical-lifestyle knowledge graph. It detects unsupported omissions in LLM outputs and shows that computable evidence constraints can make clinical omissions measurable and correctable.
tldr_zh: T2D-Bench是一个针对2型糖尿病LLM输出的基准测试和证据门控评估框架，基于多层临床-生活方式知识图谱构建。它能检测LLM输出中无依据的遗漏，并表明可计算的证据约束可使临床遗漏变得可测量和可纠正。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够为2型糖尿病生成临床流畅的建议，但往往无法满足指南约束或明确论证与生活方式相关的血糖主张的合理性。我们提出T2D-Bench——一个可重复的基准测试与证据门控评估框架，用于检验LLM输出是否满足显式、可图化检查的证据要求。T2D-Bench基于多层临床-生活方式知识图谱构建，该图谱融合了生物医学主干（UMLS、DrugBank、SIDER）、可计算的ADA诊疗标准规则，以及通过机制桥梁与血糖实验室效应相连接的生活方式知识。在涵盖诊断、用药安全及对抗性生活方式冲突的100个结构化病例中，基线输出在GPT-4o-mini上35%的案例、在GPT-4o上33%的案例未能通过基准定义的证据路径检查。证据门控机制可检测无依据的遗漏，并通过约束性修订使输出达到与基准定义证据要求相一致的验证器级合规性。这些结果表明，可计算的证据约束能够使无依据的临床遗漏在针对糖尿病的LLM输出中变得显式、可测量且可纠正。

title: RASC+: Retrieval-Constrained LLM Adjudication for Clinical Value Set Authoring
summary: Clinical value sets define the standardized terminology codes used in quality measurement, phenotyping, cohort construction, and clinical decision support. The recently introduced Retrieval-Augmented Set Completion (RASC) benchmark showed that direct zero-shot large language model (LLM) generation is poorly suited to this task: clinical code systems are large, version-controlled, and not reliably memorized by language models. We study a stage-wise alternative in which candidate-pool construction is optimized for recall and a constrained LLM adjudicator is optimized for candidate selection. On the full 3,744-value-set RASC test split, Qwen3-based retrieval with vocabulary-aware expansion and code-display rescue retrieval increases candidate-pool recall from the original RASC retrieval baseline of 0.553 to 0.730; on the held-out-publisher stratum, pool recall is 0.655. The higher-recall pool alone is not sufficient: applying the original SAPBert cross-encoder to this expanded pool gives full-test macro F1 of 0.287 and held-out-publisher macro F1 of 0.233. Replacing the stage-2 selector with blinded GPT-5 adjudication over the same pool increases full-test macro F1 to 0.549 and held-out-publisher macro F1 to 0.533. These results show that retrieval-constrained LLM adjudication can substantially improve value set completion while preserving the safety constraint that all returned codes must come from an auditable candidate pool.
tldr: This paper introduces a retrieval-constrained LLM adjudication approach for clinical value set authoring, demonstrating that separating candidate-pool construction (optimized for recall) from constrained LLM selection (optimized for precision) significantly improves performance over direct LLM generation on the RASC benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种检索约束的大语言模型裁决方法用于临床值集编撰，通过将候选池构建（优化召回率）与受限的LLM选择（优化精确率）分离，在RASC基准上显著优于直接LLM生成。
summary_zh: 临床价值集定义了用于质量测量、表型分析、队列构建和临床决策支持的标准化术语代码。近期引入的检索增强集完成（RASC）基准表明，直接使用零样本大语言模型（LLM）生成并不适合此任务：临床代码系统规模庞大、具有版本控制，且语言模型无法可靠记忆。我们研究了一种分阶段替代方案，其中候选池构建针对召回率进行优化，而受约束的LLM裁决器则针对候选选择进行优化。在完整的3744个价值集RASC测试集上，基于Qwen3的检索结合词汇感知扩展和代码显示救援检索，将候选池召回率从原始RASC检索基线的0.553提升至0.730；在保留出版者层级上，候选池召回率为0.655。仅靠高召回率候选池并不足够：将原始SAPBert交叉编码器应用于此扩展候选池后，全测试集的宏平均F1为0.287，保留出版者层的宏平均F1为0.233。用盲化GPT-5裁决替换阶段二选择器后，在同一候选池上全测试集宏平均F1提升至0.549，保留出版者层宏平均F1提升至0.533。这些结果表明，受检索约束的LLM裁决能够显著改进价值集完成，同时保留所有返回代码必须来自可审计候选池的安全性约束。
